purpose: Confirmation of the 8M comparison with two new training seeds (22345, 32345), fixed before training and before the result of the seed-12345 development run sel1m_train8m_fast_pbt_probe_decay was known. Per seed: standard ParT on train8m_head with start LRs 1e-3 and 3e-3 (the two best on seed 12345; the selected checkpoint is the better member on sel1m_tail) against fast windowed PBT with cool-down probes, the final LR decay of standard ParT and its LR range up to 3e-3 (sel1m_train8m_fast_pbt_probe_decay, unchanged). Selection on sel1m_tail; the holdout does not choose. Primary comparison: PBT minus standard ParT per seed and averaged over the two seeds; seed 12345 is development and is not part of the confirmation. These runs start only if the seed-12345 run is not clearly worse than standard ParT; that decision and its reason are recorded before they start.
